sloka: नियतः समुदाचारो भक्तिर्भर्तरि चोत्तमा ।यन्न हन्ति दशग्रीवं स महात्मा कृतागसम् ।निमित्तमात्रं रामस्तु वधे तस्य भविष्यति ।। ५.५९.३४ ।।।।
transliteration: niyataḥ samudācāro bhaktirbhartari cottamā ।yanna hanti daśagrīvaṁ sa mahātmā kṛtāgasam ।nimittamātraṁ rāmastu vadhe tasya bhaviṣyati ।। 5.59.34 ।।।।

translations.english: "Ravana is a great soul because, even though he has done harm to her, he is not killed. This is because Sita being a chaste woman of good conduct and deep devotion towards her husband (she refrained from killing Ravana as she wanted her husband to do that.)
